evidence_norm_profile.sample_size_norm: coverage studies report >=500 Monte Carlo replications per cell with >=1000 bootstrap resamples; multiple sample sizes to separate finite-sample from asymptotic behavior
evidence_norm_profile.control_design_norm: a known-answer control (Gaussian t-interval exact coverage) plus a nominal-level reference line is standard
evidence_norm_profile.effect_reporting_norm: coverage with Monte Carlo standard error; interval width reported jointly with coverage; per-seed variability disclosed
evidence_norm_profile.negative_result_norm: undercoverage findings are publishable attribution results when the deficit exceeds Monte Carlo error and the estimand is correctly matched
